introHtml: Microwave safe hot cold packs let your team or clients enjoy soothing heat therapy without needing a microwave-safe container or extra steps. Unlike standard gel packs that require boiling water, these packs heat up in seconds in any office breakroom microwave. The flexible gel beads inside conform to shoulders, backs, or knees, making them ideal for corporate wellness kits or safety rewards. Choose from shapes like the Small Round Gel Beads pack or the larger Lower Back Thermal Wrap for targeted relief.
